constraints.definition: CHECK ((((phase = ANY (ARRAY['prepare'::text, 'load'::text])) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (request_digest IS NULL)) OR ((phase = ANY (ARRAY['commit'::text, 'recover'::text])) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (request_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (request_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

CHECK ((((phase = 'recover'::text) AND (key_policy_generation IS NULL) AND (key_binding IS NULL)) OR ((phase <> 'recover'::text) AND (key_policy_generation IS NOT NULL) AND (key_policy_generation > 0) AND (key_binding IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(key_binding) = 'object'::text))))

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX encrypted_delivery_checks_pkey ON garden_control.encrypted_delivery_checks USING btree (backend_pid, transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX encrypted_delivery_contexts_backend_pid_transaction_id_key ON garden_control.encrypted_delivery_contexts USING btree (backend_pid, transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX encrypted_delivery_contexts_pkey ON garden_control.encrypted_delivery_contexts USING btree (token_hash)
CREATE INDEX encrypted_delivery_expiry ON garden_control.encrypted_delivery_contexts USING btree (authority_expires_at)

verification.whole_prior_function_catalog_preservatio: The guarded apply transaction captured its exact prestate and required equality after the six intended encryption EXECUTE removals. The external preflight independently captured six legacy function bodies/ACLs plus audit, not the entire 143-function catalog. The fresh complete post-apply inventory is not represented as an independent external before/after comparison.
verification.normalization: Only search_path whitespace was normalized when comparing the source to PostgreSQL catalog output; all identifiers, arguments, bodies and privilege bindings were exact. PostgreSQL 18 NOT NULL catalog constraints were checked separately against all eighteen NOT NULL columns.

checks.name: exact_read_only_request
checks.detail: Exact pinned 23 statements; first statement SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY.

checks.name: complete_transaction_result
checks.detail: All 23 statement results returned; no error or partial-result substitution.

checks.name: database_identity
checks.detail: Exact database, session owner, effective migrator and PostgreSQL version match fresh preflight.

checks.name: deployment_binding
checks.detail: Exact isolated staging project, branch, repository and database binding.

checks.name: migration_history
checks.detail: All 16 ordered hashes match merged source; all 15 prior applied_at values unchanged.

checks.name: role_catalog
checks.detail: Every role flag, configuration and expiry matches the preflight catalog.

checks.name: owner_memberships
checks.detail: Exact complete owner/grantor/admin/inherit/set rows remain unchanged.

checks.name: new_table_protection
checks.detail: Both exact new tables have migrator ownership and enabled, forced RLS.

checks.name: empty_data
checks.detail: Two new delivery tables and twelve retained lifecycle-control tables are empty; encryption material tables are not selected by these 23 statements.

checks.name: column_definitions
checks.detail: All 23 column names, exact types, nullability and absence of defaults/identity/generated expressions match the source contract.

checks.name: owner_only_policies
checks.detail: Exactly one owner-only policy per new table, with exact USING/CHECK expressions.

checks.name: new_function_sources
checks.detail: All 15 exact signatures, prosrc SHA256 values, owners, languages, security modes, search_path and effective runtime execute sets match reviewed merged source.

checks.name: complete_new_function_acls
checks.detail: Exactly fifteen owner ACL entries and eight intended runtime entries; no other grantee or grant option.

checks.name: deferred_triggers
checks.detail: Both exact AFTER INSERT ROW triggers are enabled and initially deferred, with no condition, arguments or update-column restriction.

checks.name: check_constraint_expressions
checks.detail: All nine source CHECK expressions match independently normalized PostgreSQL expressions; only text literal coercion, IN/ANY and BETWEEN expansion are normalized.

checks.name: keys_and_constraint_inventory
checks.detail: Five exact primary/unique/foreign keys, eighteen NOT NULL constraints, nine CHECKs and two trigger constraints; all validated with exact deferral properties.

checks.name: no_runtime_raw_table_privileges
checks.detail: No table or column access for any of the twelve runtime capabilities.

checks.name: no_other_table_acl_grantee
checks.detail: No non-owner table ACL entry, including unknown grantees.

checks.name: six_legacy_revocations
checks.detail: All six exact old bodies are unchanged; only garden_encryption EXECUTE is removed from each ACL, preserving clear_policy_context grants to research and audit reader.

checks.name: audit_preserved
checks.detail: Exact audit signature, owner, security mode, prosrc hash and ACL match the independent fresh preflight.

checks.name: index_inventory
checks.detail: All four exact indexes, their columns, uniqueness and valid/ready flags match source constraints and the explicit expiry index.

checks.name: prior_function_inventory
checks.detail: All 143 current prior-function signatures match the merged migration inventory, with migrator ownership, well-formed retained definition hashes, no PUBLIC EXECUTE or grant options. No external full-catalog prestate was available for independent before/after hash comparison.

limitations: Full prior-function preservation was enforced by the reviewed atomic apply pre/post guard; this independent readback has no external pre-apply snapshot of all 143 definition hashes.

Function volatility/strictness/return type and global pre-existing forced-RLS inventory were guarded during application but not selected by the frozen 23 readback statements; root owns separate supplementary readback.
The empty-data observation here covers two new delivery and twelve lifecycle-control tables. Root separately checks six encrypted-content/key tables.
This verifies staged schema and empty retained state; it activates no runtime/provider/key and certifies no production traffic.

guard_review_history.finding: The first draft did not require the exact multiset of expected owner/grantor membership rows. V2 requires all twenty-six rows with exact admin/inherit/set flags and rejects omissions, duplicates and drift. The final bundle changes only source/provenance bindings to verified PR72.

v2_review.scope: Independent local exact-source stage16 bundle review; no builder build, SQL execution, cloud query, provider mutation or application source edit
v2_review.verdict: No remaining concrete blocker in the prepared v2 bundle; actual PostgreSQL CI, verified merge, fresh preflight and merged-source rebinding remain required
limits: Existing stage15 observation is historical, not a fresh provider read.
Expected owner pattern is required for all13 roles and must match fresh target metadata at application time; this review does not independently establish all current role rows.
Parser and pure classification tests do not prove PostgreSQL execution or adapter atomicity.
The draft source is unmerged: required actual PostgreSQL CI and verified merge/source-byte comparison precede any apply.
No key, identity, authority, content, runtime activation or erasure operation is included.

final_binding_review.verdict: Final metadata/source rebinding passes mechanical review; execution statements exactly retain reviewed V2
final_binding_review.scope: Local artifact and Git-object comparison only; no cloud query, SQL apply, build invocation or source edit
limits: Root-provided fresh preflight is checked as a pinned observation; reviewer made no new provider query.
The unchanged in-transaction guards must still succeed on one adapter-owned backend/transaction.
Root owns application, uncertain-outcome handling and post-COMMIT readback.
